title: Change Partner Portal PIN
description: Create a new PIN for the partner portal. The new PIN must differ from your current PIN.

messages.pinChanged: PIN successfully changed. You will be redirected to the portal.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.locked: Access is temporarily locked after too many failed attempts.
errors.weakPin: New PIN is too weak or identical to your current PIN.

validation.pinSameAsOld: New PIN must differ from your current PIN.
